title: 第七十回 狼心逞乱第六十九回 倒立人
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 公孙配瘫软在地，裤裆湿透，双腿战栗。完延秃匂掩鼻挥手，吩咐兵士：“拖下去，权作人质。若其有诈，回头再剐了这厮！”
西塘关上，月上中天。关外戈壁荒山，苍莽寂寂，荒凉无遗。
倒立人飘荡关上，见城头白旗猎猎，城中遮门闭户，一片死寂，惟一队木车，月下入城，跟车兵士行如护灵，垂头丧气，哀肃低沉，不禁摇头一叹：“未料，他竟死了！”
翌日，两军对垒。风旗猎猎，黑云压城。秃鹫盘旋于空，若得死神传讯，只待饕餮“剩”宴。
完延秃匂端坐销金伞下，盘膝竹榻。坐下巨象颈系花环，身披赤毯，长鼻昂然。身后，罴象成阵，嘶吼声声，震野惊心。再看西塘关前，人马亦是一字摆开。只是阵前横陈木车，车载木箱，不知藏何玄机。完延秃匂见状，睥睨一笑，扬鞭指车道：“其等欲抬棺决死乎？”
倒立人桀桀怪笑，声犹夜枭：“棺小车少，只怕纳不得其等枯骨！大帅且先观战，待吾先挫其锐，令其倒戈而降，不战而胜！”
完延秃匂颔首。倒立人掐诀念咒，一团幽云自阵中翻出，飘至关前讨战。西塘关上，一朵祥云亦是腾起，徐至近前，云上却无人。倒立人桀桀一声怪笑：“障眼之法，雕虫小技！是何妖孽，为何不敢真身示人？”未料，身后一声冷笑：“颠倒怪孽，逆道妖人，汝何有眼无珠耶？”
倒立人浑身一颤，急转回身，惊骇：“你未死？”
“尔不灭，何言吾死！”孤鹤雁冷冷一笑。
倒立人双掌并推，欲再出逆脉销魂咒。孤鹤雁早有防备，腕间一抖，一条紫绫破空而出，宛若神龙探爪，电掣而至。倒立人足尖疾点，残月兵刃化出两道寒芒，欲断紫绫。怎知此宝厉害，紫绫倏如游龙显圣，当空舒卷，陡现七彩华光。寒芒未至，瞬被吸走，若龙吸水！
倒立人大惊，身形陀螺急旋，一化为三，各持刀、剑、索鞭，三路齐攻，诡影迷离。孤鹤雁慧眼如炬，早辨其身，紫绫一抖，缠住持鞭那身；复得一抖，倒立人立时头上脚下，犹被拨乱反正！
倒立人本习颠倒逆乱之法，一身法力皆自倒逆。此刻竟被翻转，犹蛇被掐七寸，法力尽失，咒语徒然，动弹不得！
“这……是何法宝？！”倒立人惊问。
孤鹤雁淡然一笑，拂袖道：“此乃七彩幻色紫绫，南极仙翁驯系灵鹿所用。此绫取万丈天蚕丝，以天地七色为本，合阴阳五行为基，汲日月精华，沾仙翁灵光。要长便长，赋灵见光；刚柔相济，刃斩不断。你那些颠倒阴阳、逆乱时序之术，在它面前，不过萤火之光！”
“吾问你，慕其明何在？你唤其出来，吾饶你一死。”
倒立人未答，却闻一支响箭裂空，城头梆子急响。原来，完延秃匂在下观战，见倒立人被缚，动弹不得，料其必败，遂摘下颈戴金刚圈，口念法咒，打向云头。年终至早有防备，一眼瞥见，急发响箭。孤鹤雁闻声，紫绫一抖，倒立人如布偶被牵，身不由己，迎头撞上金刚圈！
但听一声凄谲诡啸，倒立人身形被击得粉碎，化作一股黑烟，如影飘散。黑烟初聚人形，时又飘散，隐约可见头下脚上于其中挣扎痛苦之状，终渐消淡，归于虚无。孤鹤雁冷冷一笑：“终于，尔免受颠倒之苦，可安心躺平矣。”
西塘关前，将士欢声雷动。完延秃匂却捶胸顿足，大叫其苦。年终至见时机已至，令旗一挥，三声炮响震天，大军尽数杀出。完延秃匂虽惊，却未失方寸，稳住心神，口念咒语，催动罴象阵来攻。
孤鹤雁立于云头，双手合十，唇翕微动，口诵《驭音心经》，骤施驭音心法。霎时，无数驭蜂受召，钻箱而出，迎住罴象，四下蛰攻。罴象眼无遮护，慌不择路，掉头狂奔。冲突践踏，致落马者无数。完延秃匂急念法咒，犹不能逆转。兵将丢戈弃刃，自相踩踏，因此溃如山崩。
见大势已去，完延秃匂只得弃象乘马，亲护契麾迩罕夺路而奔，欲回大营，重拾残兵。未至，却见大营方向火起，浓烟蔽日。兵士飞报：大营被劫，焚烧殆尽！完延秃匂魂飞天外。此时，岳将军又依计杀至，完延秃匂无心恋战，拼死护住契麾迩罕，仅余数十骑，朝库幙乞措大沙漠仓皇逃窜。
孤鹤雁按落云头，遍寻慕其明。正见岳将军，急问：“岳将军，可有擒获慕其明？”岳将军先是下马一拜，拱手称贺：“孤仙人运筹帷幄，三策破敌，真乃吾朝之幸，社稷之幸！吾知仙人所系，俘获一人，尚未审问，仙人可亲问之。”随即挥手，部下牵来一老翁，衣饰华贵，绳捆索缚。
孤鹤雁便问：“汝是何人？”老翁答：“吾乃契麾迩罕帐前御厨，人称罗斯汤人。”
孤鹤雁再问：“汝可知慕其明下落？”罗斯汤人摇首，一脸茫然：“不知此人，更未闻此名！”
孤鹤雁道：“其与完延秃匂私交，汝或未知，……”孰料，罗斯汤人竟仰天大笑。孤鹤雁愕然：“汝因何发笑？”
罗斯汤人道：“完延秃匂乃吾义子，与吾无话不讲。若是军机，吾或有未知；但若是一人，吾不知其因何瞒我！”
孤鹤雁听得心头一沉。
正此时，兵士飞骑来请：“孤仙人、岳将军，年大将军恭请二位至帅府议事。”
来至帅府，年终至见二人，满面春风，趋步上前，先冲孤鹤雁深施一礼，拱手言贺：“仙人三策破敌，吾军大捷，恭喜仙人，贺喜仙人！聊备庆功喜宴，酌为仙人请功。”
孤鹤雁问：“贼首可有擒住？”年终至道：“已遣轻骑去追。敌寇仅余数十骑窜入沙漠，瓮中之鳖，不足为患！”孤鹤雁大惊：“遣兵去追？将军莫非未预先设伏？！”年终至不以为意：“沙漠平阔，一览无余，不便设伏。彼逃入其中，亦是自寻死路。吾军轻骑掩追，料其插翅难飞！”
孤鹤雁再问：“那可有擒获慕其明？”年终至道：“尚未。不过仙人勿急，战场清点完毕，自有消息。”孤鹤雁敛容道：“如此，何喜之有？战场未清，兵士尚在浴血，吾实无心宴饮！”此时众将皆至，甲胄未解，闻之默然。
忽人来报：“大将军，孤仙人家中来人求见！”孤鹤雁闻之色变——其孤身在此，家中无人知晓，怎的此刻差人来报？差者何人？所报何事？一念及此，心头剧跳。遂抬手道：“诸位且便。”匆匆而出。
“小诗丐，怎的是你？！”孤鹤雁来至后府，见一人面色惨白，衣衫染血，正是久未谋面小诗丐，不由大惊。小诗丐一见孤鹤雁，趋前两步，扑通跪倒，泣不成声：“鹤雁哥……不、不好了……家中出事了！”
孤鹤雁心头一紧，搀起小诗丐：“家中出了何事？你快请起，慢慢说！”小诗丐喘息片刻，断断续续：“狼人，狼人……他疯了！”孤鹤雁闻言大惊：“疯了！如何疯了？”
原来，孤鹤雁离了青?山，小诗丐与狼人陪伴顾长世，每日弈棋饮酒，闲话清谈，倒也无事。然天有不测风云，祸福难料。那日，三人饮酒叙旧，谈及往事，狼人怨声切恨：“吾在天庭，本自安好。谁料仙途多舛，遭人构陷，玉帝偏信，方致吾今日之难。想吾本来面目，也是仙容俊美，仪态翩翩，奈何……唉！”
顾长世醉眼朦胧，趁酒解劝：“人生如梦，得失难量。看淡劫难，方得从容。你看老夫，初历丧子之痛，痛不欲生。后余生留念，安心为善，善待己身。竟不意得上天眷怜，让吾收养孤鹤雁，不啻新生。”狼人闻之不快，辩道：“鹤雁仙临凡世，爷爷幸遇，还是命，不可同日而语。”
顾长世再劝：“仙灵亦是修行！就说那《驭音心经》——本天书一卷，载天地音律之妙，传禅修心悟之典，慧智深瀚。得之者可驭万物，可造变化。无数人觊觎，企之得天下。鹤雁却不然，其以苍生为念，淡名利，重灵修，不以宝卷行私，心念念护之，不使其落于妖邪之手，这才有不凡仙历，岂道不是？”

狼人闻听《驭音心经》，顿起贪念，遂不住劝酒，探问《心经》下落：“爷爷，心经既如此灵罕，为何不将其重归达摩洞？”顾长世慨然一笑：“灵云寺洞出宝盒，天下尽知，放归原处，岂非再引祸水？”狼人故作沉吟：“既如此，那当寻一秘地藏之，方妥。”顾长世醉意醺然：“那是自然。此处唯吾与鹤雁知，自是无虞。”狼人再道：“还须看守才是。”顾长世闻言一笑：“守宝之地，几曾不失？宝重在护，不在守！”狼人故作惊诧：“无人看守？倘生意外该当如何？”顾长世哈哈一笑：“老夫每日一察，何来意外？”此言一出，天机尽泄！
“什么？！”孤鹤雁身形一晃，如遭五雷轰顶：“狼人掘了奶奶坟墓，盗出《驭音心经》？！”
“还不止此。”小诗丐拭泪：“狼人极通音律，又识天书文字，得卷之后，日夜参悟，竟如顽石开窍，窥破玄微，再获无上灵力。自此，通灵上天，搅了‘天庭乐典’，引祸青?山。”
狼人原是天庭乐部仙官来着，自是极通音律，得卷之后参悟极快。那日清晨，其于青?山巅吐纳修炼，忽觉内息翻江倒海，心念如沸，遂口诵心经，仰天一声长啸。但见山巅金光炸裂，一道音波直贯九霄，乱石崩飞，万兽齐鸣，天地为之震颤！
狼人抚卷狂喜：“哈哈，天不负我，竟让我机缘巧合，重获仙力！”转念思忖：“不知今日天庭如何？吾当借此一试灵通，既雪旧怨，亦立威名。”念及至此，掐诀念咒，云至南天门。

却说那日，正值天庭乐典，玉帝大宴群仙。瑶池之上，霞光万道，瑞霭千重；琼台中央，仙女翩跹，编钟磬鸣，仙乐飘飘，一派祥和。忽尔，天动地颤，案几摇摆，琵琶弦崩，古筝丝断，仙女捂胸四顾，个个心慌意乱。复有阵阵怨声凄喊，破空而来，大煞光景。玉帝不胜震怒，强稳心神，抚案叱问：“何来骚扰？竟敢亵渎仙庭盛典？”值日功曹慌来禀报：“启禀玉帝，南天门外忽现无数冤魂屈鬼之声，但闻其音，不见其形，不知何故也！”众仙闻言皆惊。

Gongsun Pei collapsed on the ground, his crotch was soaked and his legs were trembling. Wanyan covered his nose with his bald head and waved his hand, instructing the soldiers: "Drag him down and make him a hostage. If he is cheating, turn around and chop this guy into pieces!"
Xitang is closed, the moon is in the sky. The deserted Gobi mountains outside the pass are vast, silent and desolate.
The upside-down man floated and closed the door, and saw the white flag hunting at the top of the city. The doors were closed in the city, and there was a dead silence. There was only a group of wooden carts entering the city under the moon. The soldiers following the cart were walking like guardian spirits. They were dejected and mournful. They couldn't help but shake their heads and sighed: "Unexpectedly, he died!"
The next day, the two armies faced each other. The wind flags are hunting, and the dark clouds are pressing down on the city. The vultures are circling in the sky, and if they receive a message from the God of Death, they will only be waiting for a gluttonous "leftover" feast.
Wan Yan, a bald man, sat under a pinned golden umbrella, cross-legged on a bamboo couch. Sitting down, the giant elephant tied a garland around its neck, wore a red blanket, and raised its long trunk. Behind them, the elephants formed a formation, and their roars were shocking. Looking at the front of Xitang Pass again, the people and horses are also spread out. There are just wooden carts and wooden boxes in front of the array. I don’t know what the mystery is. Seeing this, Wanyan Tujiao smiled scornfully and pointed at the driveway with his whip: "Do they want to carry the coffin and commit suicide?"
The upside-down man Jie Jie laughed strangely, his voice was like that of a night owl: "There are few coffins and small carts, I'm afraid I won't be able to accommodate the withered bones! Commander, please observe the battle first, and wait for me to blunt his sharpness, make him switch sides and surrender, and win without a fight!"
Wan Yanbald nodded. The inverted man made a hand and chanted a mantra, and a dark cloud emerged from the formation and floated to the front of the pass to fight. At the gate of Xitang, an auspicious cloud also rose up, approaching slowly, but there was no one on the cloud. The upside-down man Jie Jie laughed strangely: "It's a trick to blind your eyes! What kind of monster is he? Why don't you dare to show your true identity to others?" Unexpectedly, a sneer came from behind: "You are a weird monster and a perverse monster. Why are you blind?"
The upside-down man shuddered and turned around, horrified: "Are you not dead?"
"You are immortal, why should I die!" Gu Heyan smiled coldly.
The upside-down man pushes his palms together, trying to cast the Reversing Vein Ecstasy Curse again. Gu Heyan was on guard for a long time. With a flick of his wrist, a piece of purple silk burst out of the air, like a divine dragon reaching for its claws with lightning. The inverted man's toes were pointed, and the waning moon's sword turned into two rays of cold light, trying to break the purple silk ribbon. How could one know that this treasure is so powerful? The purple silk silk suddenly appeared like a wandering dragon, unrolling its roll in the air, and suddenly appeared with colorful brilliance. Before the cold light arrives, it is instantly sucked away, like a dragon sucking water!
The upside-down man was startled, and his figure spun rapidly, turning one into three, each holding a knife, a sword, and a rope whip, and attacked from all three directions, creating a blur of shadows. Lone Crane Yan's eyes were as sharp as a torch, and he had already identified his body. With a flick of his purple silk silk, he wrapped around the whip-wielding body. With another flick, the upside-down man's head and feet were immediately turned upside down.
Inverted people are accustomed to the method of inversion and chaos, and all their magic power is reversed. At this moment, it was turned over, like a snake pinched seven inches, all its magic power was lost, the spell was in vain, and it couldn't move!
"What kind of magic weapon is this?!" the upside-down man asked in shock.
Gu Heyan smiled indifferently, and said with a flick of his sleeves: "This is a seven-color fantasy purple damask, used by Antarctic immortals to tame the spirit deer. This damask is made from ten thousand feet of heavenly silk, based on the seven colors of heaven and earth, and combined with the five elements of yin and yang. The essence of the sun and the moon is soaked in the spiritual light of the Immortal. If you want it, it will grow, and you will be able to see the light. The combination of strength and softness can keep cutting. Your techniques of reversing yin and yang and reversing the order of time are no more than the light of a firefly!"
"I ask you, where is Mu Qiming? You call him out, and I will spare your death."
The upside-down man didn't answer, but he heard an arrow cracking through the air and a clapper banging rapidly on the city wall. It turned out that Wanyan Tujie was watching the battle below and saw that the upside-down man was bound and unable to move. He expected that he would be defeated, so he took off the diamond ring around his neck, chanted a mantra, and hit the cloud head. Be on guard at the end of the year and early in the morning. If you catch a glimpse, you will be quick to fire an arrow. Hearing the sound, Lone Crane Yan's purple silk trembled, and the upside-down man was like a rag doll being pulled. He couldn't help but hit the Vajra Circle head-on!
But after hearing a mournful howl, the inverted figure was shattered into pieces and turned into a puff of black smoke, drifting away like a shadow. The black smoke first gathered the human figure, then drifted away again, and the head, feet and feet could be vaguely seen struggling in pain. Finally, it gradually faded and returned to nothingness. Gu Heyan smiled coldly: "Finally, you are free from the pain of being upside down and can rest peacefully."
In front of Xitang Pass, the soldiers cheered thunderously. However, Wan Yan was bald and beat his chest and stamped his feet, shouting that he was suffering. Seeing that the time had come at the end of the year, the flag was waved, three cannons were fired, and all the troops came out. Although Wanyan Tujie was frightened, he did not lose an inch. He calmed his mind, chanted a spell, and activated the elephant formation to attack.
The solitary crane and wild goose stood on the head of the clouds, put their hands together, moved their lips slightly, recited the "Yin Yu Heart Sutra", and suddenly performed the Yu Yin Heart Sutra. In an instant, countless bees were summoned, came out of the box, greeted the elephant, and stung in all directions. The elephant's eyes were unprotected and he panicked, turning around and running wildly. Conflicts and trampling have caused countless people to fall. Wanyan Tujie recited the mantra hurriedly, but it could not be reversed. The generals abandoned their weapons and trampled on each other, thus collapsing like a mountain avalanche.
Seeing that the situation was over, Wanyan Tugao had no choice but to abandon his elephant and ride on his horse, protect Qi's subordinates and rush for the road, hoping to return to the camp and pick up the remaining soldiers. Before they arrived, they saw a fire breaking out in the direction of the camp and thick smoke covering the sun. The soldiers reported: The camp was robbed and burned to the ground! Wanyan's bald soul flies into the sky. At this time, General Yue followed his plan and killed him again. Wan Yan Tuqi had no intention of fighting and tried his best to protect Qi Hui Erhan. Only a few dozen horses were left, and they fled in a hurry across the desert to beg for help in Kumu.
The lonely crane and wild goose press down on the cloud head, searching and admiring its brightness. Seeing General Yue, he asked urgently: "General Yue, have you captured and admired Qiming?" General Yue first dismounted his horse, bowed, and congratulated: "The lonely immortal planned the strategy and defeated the enemy with three strategies. It is really a blessing for our dynasty and the country! I know where the immortal is, and I have captured one person. I have not yet interrogated him, so the immortal can ask him personally." Then he waved his hand, and his subordinates brought an old man, luxuriously dressed and bound with ropes.
Gu Heyan then asked: "Who are you?" The old man replied: "I am the imperial cook in front of Qi's army, and I am known as Luo Tangren."
Gu Heyan asked again: "Do you know the whereabouts of Mu Qiming?" The man from Luositang shook his head with a look of confusion on his face: "I don't know this person, let alone his name!"
Gu Heyan said: "You may not know about his personal relationship with Wanyan Tujia..." Unexpectedly, the man from Luositang actually looked up to the sky and laughed. Gu Heyan was stunned: "Why are you laughing?"
Luo Tangren said: "Wan Yan Tu Kao is my adopted son, and he talks to me about everything. If it is a military plane, I may not know anything about it; but if it is a person, I don't know why he hid it from me!"
Gu Heyan's heart sank when he heard this.
At this time, soldiers came flying to invite them: "Gu Xianren, General Yue, General Nian respectfully invites you two to discuss matters in the Commander-in-Chief's Mansion."
When they arrived at the Marshal's Mansion, they saw the two of them at the end of the year. They were full of spring breeze. They stepped forward, gave a deep salute to Gu Heyan, raised his hands and congratulated: "The immortal defeated the enemy with three strategies, and our army won a great victory. Congratulations to the immortal, congratulations to the immortal! Let's prepare a celebration banquet, and I will take credit for the immortal."
Gu Heyan asked: "Can the leader of the thief be captured?" At the end of the year, he said: "We have sent light cavalry to chase. The enemy only has dozens of cavalry running into the desert. There are no turtles in the urn, not enough to cause trouble!" Gu Heyan was shocked: "Send troops to chase? Will you? Didn't the army set up an ambush in advance?!" Nian Zhi didn't care: "The desert is vast and unobstructed, and it is difficult for him to escape into it. Our army will be chasing him with light cavalry, and he will not be able to fly!"
Gu Heyan asked again: "Is there anyone who can capture Ming Qiming?" The end of the year said: "Not yet. But don't be impatient, immortal. The battlefield has been counted and there will be news." Gu Heyan said calmly: "So, how happy are you? The battlefield has not been cleared, the soldiers are still bathing in blood, and I really have no intention of feasting!" At this time, all the generals arrived, their armor was not removed, and they were silent after hearing it.
Suddenly someone came to report: "General, someone came to Guxian's house to ask for a visit!" Gu Heyan's expression changed when he heard that - he was here alone, and no one at home knew about it, so why did he send someone to report at this moment? Who is the bad one? What was reported? When I think of this, my heart skips a beat. Then he raised his hand and said, "Everyone, please be ready." He hurried out.
"Little Poet Beggar, why is it you?!" Gu Heyan came to the Houfu and saw a man with a pale face and blood-stained clothes. It was the Little Poet Beggar who he hadn't seen for a long time, and he couldn't help but be shocked. When the little poet beggar saw Gu Heyan, he took two steps forward, fell to his knees, and burst into tears: "Brother Heyan... no, it's not good... something happened at home!"
Gu Heyan's heart tightened, and he helped the little poet beggar: "What happened at home? Please get up quickly and speak slowly!" The little poet beggar breathed for a moment and said intermittently: "Werewolf, werewolf... he is crazy!" Hearing this, Gu Heyan was shocked: "Crazy! Why are you crazy?"
It turns out that Gu Heyan left Qingshan Mountain, and the little poet beggar and the werewolf accompanied Gu Changshi, playing chess, drinking, and chatting every day, but nothing happened. However, there are unforeseen circumstances, and misfortune and fortune are unpredictable. That day, the three of them drank and reminisced about the past, and the werewolf complained bitterly: "I am in heaven, and I am at peace. Who would have expected that my path to immortality would be troubled, and I would be framed by others, and the Jade Emperor would only believe in me, which is why I am in trouble today. Thinking about my true face, I am also a fairy with a handsome face and graceful manners, but... alas!"
Gu Changshi, drunken and hazy-eyed, took advantage of the wine to calm down and persuaded: "Life is like a dream, gains and losses are difficult to measure. Only by looking down on disaster can you be calm. Look at me, I have experienced the pain of losing a child for the first time, and I don't want to live anymore. I will remember it for the rest of my life, and do good deeds with peace of mind. Treat yourself well. Unexpectedly, God has given me mercy and allowed me to adopt Gu Heyan, which is like a new life." The werewolf was unhappy when he heard this, and argued: "Grandpa is lucky enough to meet him, but it's not the same."
Gu Changshi urged again: "Fairy spirits are also practicing! Let's talk about the "Heart Sutra of Controlling Sounds" - a volume of this heavenly book, which contains the wonderful rhythms of heaven and earth, and conveys the classics of meditation and enlightenment. It has profound wisdom. Those who obtain it can control all things and create countless changes. People covet the world, but He Yan is not like that. He cares about the common people, pays little attention to fame and fortune, does not use the treasure scroll for personal gain, and protects it carefully to prevent it from falling into the hands of evil spirits. This is how he has extraordinary immortality, isn't it?"
The werewolf suddenly became greedy after hearing the "Heart Sutra of Controlling Sounds". He couldn't help but ask for a drink and inquired about the whereabouts of the "Heart Sutra": "Grandpa, since the Heart Sutra is so rare, why not return it to Bodhidharma Cave?" Gu Changshi said with emotion. Smiling: "The treasure box came out of the Lingyun Temple cave, and everyone in the world knows it. If it is released to its original place, wouldn't it cause trouble again?" The werewolf pretended to think deeply: "In that case, it would be appropriate to find a secret place to hide it." Gu Changshi was drunk. Ran: "That's natural. Only He Yan and I know that there is no danger here." The werewolf said again: "We still need to guard it." Gu Changshi smiled when he heard this: "How often do you not lose the place where you guard the treasure? The most important thing is to protect the treasure. , not guarding!" The werewolf pretended to be surprised: "No one is watching? What if something happens?" Gu Changshi laughed: "I check it every day, why is it unexpected?" As soon as he said this, the secret was revealed!
"What?!" Gu Heyan's figure swayed, as if he was struck by five thunders: "The werewolf dug up grandma's grave and stole the "Heart Sutra of Yuyin"?!"
"That's not all." The little poet wiped away his tears: "The werewolf is very good at music, and he also knows the words of the heavenly book. After he got the scroll, he studied it day and night, and he was like a stubborn stone that opened his eyes, peered through the mystery, and gained supreme spiritual power. From then on, he channeled spirits to heaven, disturbed the 'Heavenly Music Code', and caused trouble to Qing? Mountain."
The werewolf was originally an immortal official in the Heavenly Music Club. He was very proficient in music, and he understood it very quickly after getting the volume. In the early morning of that day, while he was breathing and practicing on the top of Qingshan Mountain, he suddenly felt his breath was overwhelming and his thoughts were boiling. He then recited the Heart Sutra and looked up to the sky with a long roar. But when the golden light exploded on the top of the mountain, a sound wave penetrated the sky, rocks collapsed, all beasts roared, and the heaven and earth trembled!
The werewolf caressed the scroll and was ecstatic: "Haha, God has not failed me, and allowed me to regain my immortal power by chance!" Then he thought: "I wonder how the heaven is today? I should use this to test my psychic powers, not only to settle the old grudges, but also to establish my reputation." Thinking of this, he kneaded his hand and chanted the incantation, and went to the Nantian Gate.
But it was said that that day was at the time of the Heavenly Music Ceremony, when the Jade Emperor was giving a banquet to all the immortals. Above the Yaochi, there are thousands of rays of light and thousands of auspicious mist; in the center of the Qiongtai, fairies are dancing, chimes are ringing, and fairy music is floating, creating a peaceful atmosphere. Suddenly, the sky shook and the earth trembled, the table swayed, the pipa strings collapsed, and the guzheng silk broke. The fairies covered their breasts and looked around, all of them panicked. Again, there were bursts of complaints and screams, coming through the air, creating a terrible scene. The Jade Emperor was furious, calmed down, and asked the case: "Why are you harassing me? How dare you desecrate the grand ceremony of the Immortal Court?" The meritorious officer on duty came to report in a hurry: "To report to the Jade Emperor, there were countless voices of wronged souls outside the Nantian Gate, but when I heard the sound, I couldn't see their form, and I don't know why!" All the immortals were shocked when they heard this.
